clips.title: The story
paras: Along Darkshore's coast, a Beached Sea Turtle lies dead beneath the carriage it once hauled. A box marked with strange runes rests in the wreckage.

A dead sea turtle lies among the ancient bones scattered along Darkshore's coast. Splintered carriage boards still cling to its broad shell. The turtle was driven onto the rocks while hauling cargo, rather than stranded by sickness or disorientation. A container carved with unfamiliar, serpent-like marks lies in the wreckage, amid scavengers feeding on the remains.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Another set of sea turtle remains lie beached on the coastline. This set of remains has an abandoned carriage half buckled to the turtle's shell. Perhaps this creature was driven to the shoreline by unknown beings rather than beaching itself as some of the other remains suggested. Powerful Greymist murlocs have made the carcass of this creature their current home.
In the carriage, you find a box with strange markings on it; perhaps Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine can make sense of it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello again, friend. The work you have done on behalf of the Temple of the Moon has been outstanding. Are we to be blessed with more of your effort on our behalf?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I have heard of the kinds of carriages found on the back of that turtle. Those I do believe are naga carriages, used both in battle and in transportation of their supplies on to land. The markings on the box you found are of the naga; perhaps the creature you discovered was killed as it was heading further south... To Ashenvale maybe?
I will be sure to send this box to Darnassus with the rest of your discoveries. This is for you - thank you again for your assistance.
